```python
"""Procrastinate app and all background task definitions.

Web process: imports `procrastinate_app` to enqueue tasks.
Worker process: run with `procrastinate --app app.worker.procrastinate_app worker`
"""

import logging

import procrastinate

_logger = logging.getLogger("studyengine")

procrastinate_app = procrastinate.App(
    connector=procrastinate.AsyncPsycopgConnector(),
    import_paths=["app.worker"],
)


@procrastinate_app.task(
    name="extract_topics",
    retry=procrastinate.RetryStrategy(max_attempts=3, wait=60),
    queue="ai",
)
async def extract_topics_task(unit_id: int, course_id: int, user_id: int | None) -> None:
    from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
    from app.db import SessionLocal
    from app.models import Unit
    from app.services.ai import extract_topics_from_text, generate_unit_summary
    from app.services import topics as topics_service
    import asyncio

    db: Session = SessionLocal()
    try:
        unit = db.get(Unit, unit_id)
        if unit is None:
            return
        unit.extraction_status = "running"
        db.commit()

        all_text = "\n\n".join(m.extracted_text for m in unit.materials if m.extracted_text)
        if not all_text.strip():
            unit.extraction_status = "failed"
            db.commit()
            return

        summary_result, hierarchy_result = await asyncio.gather(
            generate_unit_summary(all_text, user_id=user_id, course_id=course_id),
            extract_topics_from_text(all_text, user_id=user_id, course_id=course_id),
            return_exceptions=True,
        )

        if isinstance(summary_result, Exception):
            _logger.exception("Unit summary generation failed: %s", summary_result)
        elif summary_result:
            unit.description = summary_result

        if isinstance(hierarchy_result, Exception):
            _logger.exception("Topic extraction failed: %s", hierarchy_result)
            unit.extraction_status = "failed"
        else:
            if hierarchy_result:
                topics_service.save_topic_hierarchy(db, course_id, unit_id, hierarchy_result)
            unit.extraction_status = "done"

        db.commit()
    except Exception:
        _logger.exception("extract_topics_task failed for unit %d", unit_id)
        unit = db.get(Unit, unit_id)
        if unit:
            unit.extraction_status = "failed"
            db.commit()
        raise
    finally:
        db.close()


@procrastinate_app.task(
    name="generate_flashcards",
    retry=procrastinate.RetryStrategy(max_attempts=2, wait=60),
    queue="ai",
)
async def generate_flashcards_task(unit_id: int, course_id: int, user_id: int | None) -> None:
    from app.db import SessionLocal
    from app.models import Unit, Topic, UnitTopic, Flashcard
    from app.services.ai import generate_flashcards as ai_generate_flashcards

    db = SessionLocal()
    try:
        unit = db.get(Unit, unit_id)
        if unit is None:
            return

        all_text = "\n\n".join(m.extracted_text for m in unit.materials if m.extracted_text)
        if not all_text.strip():
            return

        topic_names = [
            t.name
            for t in db.query(Topic).join(UnitTopic).filter(UnitTopic.unit_id == unit_id).all()
        ]

        cards = await ai_generate_flashcards(all_text, topic_names, user_id=user_id, course_id=course_id)

        for card in cards:
            db.add(Flashcard(
                unit_id=unit_id,
                course_id=course_id,
                topic_id=card.get("topic_id"),
                front=card["front"],
                back=card["back"],
            ))
        db.commit()
        _logger.info("Generated %d flashcards for unit %d", len(cards), unit_id)
    except Exception:
        _logger.exception("generate_flashcards_task failed for unit %d", unit_id)
        raise
    finally:
        db.close()


@procrastinate_app.task(
    name="generate_quiz_seed",
    retry=procrastinate.RetryStrategy(max_attempts=2, wait=30),
    queue="ai",
)
async def generate_quiz_seed_task(quiz_id: int, user_id: int | None) -> None:
    from app.db import SessionLocal
    from app.models import Quiz, QuizQuestion, Question, Topic, Material, Unit
    from app.services.ai import generate_quiz_batch
    from app.services.quiz_service import question_from_ai_dict

    db = SessionLocal()
    try:
        quiz = db.get(Quiz, quiz_id)
        if quiz is None:
            return
        quiz.seed_status = "running"
        db.commit()

        topic_ids = list({
            qq.question.topic_id
            for qq in db.query(QuizQuestion).filter_by(quiz_id=quiz_id).all()
            if qq.question and qq.question.topic_id
        })

        unit_ids = list({
            ut.unit_id
            for t in db.query(Topic).filter(Topic.id.in_(topic_ids)).all()
            for ut in t.unit_topics
        })
        all_text = "\n\n".join(
            m.extracted_text
            for uid in unit_ids
            for m in db.query(Material).filter_by(unit_id=uid).all()
            if m.extracted_text
        )

        topic_data = [
            {"name": t.name, "id": t.id}
            for t in db.query(Topic).filter(Topic.id.in_(topic_ids)).all()
        ]

        existing_prompts = [
            q.prompt
            for q in db.query(Question).filter(
                Question.topic_id.in_(topic_ids),
                Question.flagged == False,
            ).all()
        ]

        generated = await generate_quiz_batch(
            material_text=all_text,
            topics=topic_data,
            num_questions=10,
            existing_prompts=existing_prompts,
            exam_mode=False,
            user_id=user_id,
            course_id=quiz.course_id,
        )

        if not generated:
            quiz.seed_status = "failed"
            db.commit()
            return

        for i, q_data in enumerate(generated):
            question = question_from_ai_dict(q_data, topic_ids[0] if topic_ids else None, db)
            db.add(question)
            db.flush()
            db.add(QuizQuestion(quiz_id=quiz_id, question_id=question.id, position=i))

        quiz.seed_status = "ready"
        db.commit()
        _logger.info("Seeded quiz %d with %d questions", quiz_id, len(generated))
    except Exception:
        _logger.exception("generate_quiz_seed_task failed for quiz %d", quiz_id)
        q = db.get(Quiz, quiz_id)
        if q:
            q.seed_status = "failed"
            db.commit()
        raise
    finally:
        db.close()


@procrastinate_app.task(
    name="pregenerate_bank",
    retry=procrastinate.RetryStrategy(max_attempts=2, wait=120),
    queue="ai",
)
async def pregenerate_bank_task(
    course_id: int,
    unit_id: int,
    material_text: str,
    topic_names_and_ids: list[dict],
    default_topic_id: int,
    user_id: int | None,
) -> None:
    from app.routes.units_pregeneration import _background_pregenerate_bank
    await _background_pregenerate_bank(
        course_id, unit_id, material_text, topic_names_and_ids, default_topic_id, user_id=user_id
    )


@procrastinate_app.task(
    name="pregenerate_flashcards",
    retry=procrastinate.RetryStrategy(max_attempts=2, wait=120),
    queue="ai",
)
async def pregenerate_flashcards_task(
    course_id: int,
    unit_id: int,
    material_text: str,
    topic_names_and_ids: list[dict],
    user_id: int | None,
) -> None:
    from app.routes.units_pregeneration import _background_pregenerate_flashcards
    await _background_pregenerate_flashcards(
        course_id, unit_id, material_text, topic_names_and_ids, user_id=user_id
    )
```

**Important:** Before writing the file, check the actual `Flashcard` model constructor in `app/models.py` — verify whether `course_id` is a valid field (some flashcard models don't have it). Adapt the `generate_flashcards_task` accordingly.

Web process: imports `procrastinate_app` to enqueue tasks.
Worker process: run with `procrastinate --app app.worker.procrastinate_app worker`
"""

import logging

import procrastinate

_logger = logging.getLogger("studyengine")

procrastinate_app = procrastinate.App(
    connector=procrastinate.AsyncPsycopgConnector(),
    import_paths=["app.worker"],
)


@procrastinate_app.task(
    name="extract_topics",
    retry=procrastinate.RetryStrategy(max_attempts=3, wait=60),
    queue="ai",
)
async def extract_topics_task(unit_id: int, course_id: int, user_id: int | None) -> None:
    import asyncio

    from app.db import SessionLocal
    from app.models import Unit
    from app.services import topics as topics_service
    from app.services.ai import extract_topics_from_text, generate_unit_summary

    db = SessionLocal()
    try:
        unit = db.get(Unit, unit_id)
        if unit is None:
            return
        unit.extraction_status = "running"
        db.commit()

        all_text = "\n\n".join(m.extracted_text for m in unit.materials if m.extracted_text)
        if not all_text.strip():
            unit.extraction_status = "failed"
            db.commit()
            return

        summary_result, hierarchy_result = await asyncio.gather(
            generate_unit_summary(all_text, user_id=user_id, course_id=course_id),
            extract_topics_from_text(all_text, user_id=user_id, course_id=course_id),
            return_exceptions=True,
        )

        if isinstance(summary_result, Exception):
            _logger.exception("Unit summary generation failed: %s", summary_result)
        elif summary_result:
            unit.description = summary_result

        if isinstance(hierarchy_result, Exception):
            _logger.exception("Topic extraction failed: %s", hierarchy_result)
            unit.extraction_status = "failed"
        else:
            if hierarchy_result:
                topics_service.save_topic_hierarchy(db, course_id, unit_id, hierarchy_result)
            unit.extraction_status = "done"

        db.commit()
    except Exception:
        _logger.exception("extract_topics_task failed for unit %d", unit_id)
        unit = db.get(Unit, unit_id)
        if unit:
            unit.extraction_status = "failed"
            db.commit()
        raise
    finally:
        db.close()


@procrastinate_app.task(
    name="generate_flashcards",
    retry=procrastinate.RetryStrategy(max_attempts=2, wait=60),
    queue="ai",
)
async def generate_flashcards_task(unit_id: int, course_id: int, user_id: int | None) -> None:
    from app.db import SessionLocal
    from app.models import Flashcard, Topic, UnitTopic
    from app.services.ai import generate_flashcards as ai_generate_flashcards

    db = SessionLocal()
    try:
        from app.models import Unit

        unit = db.get(Unit, unit_id)
        if unit is None:
            return

        all_text = "\n\n".join(m.extracted_text for m in unit.materials if m.extracted_text)
        if not all_text.strip():
            return

        topic_names = [
            t.name
            for t in db.query(Topic).join(UnitTopic).filter(UnitTopic.unit_id == unit_id).all()
        ]

        cards = await ai_generate_flashcards(all_text, topic_names, user_id=user_id, course_id=course_id)

        for card in cards:
            db.add(Flashcard(
                unit_id=unit_id,
                course_id=course_id,
                topic_id=card.get("topic_id"),
                front=card["front"],
                back=card["back"],
            ))
        db.commit()
        _logger.info("Generated %d flashcards for unit %d", len(cards), unit_id)
    except Exception:
        _logger.exception("generate_flashcards_task failed for unit %d", unit_id)
        raise
    finally:
        db.close()


@procrastinate_app.task(
    name="generate_quiz_seed",
    retry=procrastinate.RetryStrategy(max_attempts=2, wait=30),
    queue="ai",
)
async def generate_quiz_seed_task(quiz_id: int, user_id: int | None) -> None:
    from app.db import SessionLocal
    from app.models import Material, Question, Quiz, QuizQuestion, Topic
    from app.services.ai import generate_quiz_batch
    from app.services.quiz_service import question_from_ai_dict

    db = SessionLocal()
    try:
        quiz = db.get(Quiz, quiz_id)
        if quiz is None:
            return

        course_id = quiz.unit.course_id if quiz.unit else None

        quiz.seed_status = "running"
        db.commit()

        topic_ids = list({
            qq.question.topic_id
            for qq in db.query(QuizQuestion).filter_by(quiz_id=quiz_id).all()
            if qq.question and qq.question.topic_id
        })

        unit_ids = list({
            ut.unit_id
            for t in db.query(Topic).filter(Topic.id.in_(topic_ids)).all()
            for ut in t.unit_topics
        })
        all_text = "\n\n".join(
            m.extracted_text
            for uid in unit_ids
            for m in db.query(Material).filter_by(unit_id=uid).all()
            if m.extracted_text
        )

        topic_data = [
            {"name": t.name, "id": t.id}
            for t in db.query(Topic).filter(Topic.id.in_(topic_ids)).all()
        ]

        existing_prompts = [
            q.prompt
            for q in db.query(Question).filter(
                Question.topic_id.in_(topic_ids),
                Question.flagged == False,  # noqa: E712
            ).all()
        ]

        generated = await generate_quiz_batch(
            material_text=all_text,
            topics=topic_data,
            num_questions=10,
            existing_prompts=existing_prompts,
            exam_mode=False,
            user_id=user_id,
            course_id=course_id,
        )

        if not generated:
            quiz.seed_status = "failed"
            db.commit()
            return

        for i, q_data in enumerate(generated):
            question = question_from_ai_dict(course_id, topic_ids[0] if topic_ids else None, q_data)
            db.add(question)
            db.flush()
            db.add(QuizQuestion(quiz_id=quiz_id, question_id=question.id, order=i))

        quiz.seed_status = "ready"
        db.commit()
        _logger.info("Seeded quiz %d with %d questions", quiz_id, len(generated))
    except Exception:
        _logger.exception("generate_quiz_seed_task failed for quiz %d", quiz_id)
        q = db.get(Quiz, quiz_id)
        if q:
            q.seed_status = "failed"
            db.commit()
        raise
    finally:
        db.close()
